name: manual_c9b937
claim: Passing --help to an unfamiliar CLI tool is not guaranteed to be safe or side-effect-free -- some scripts have no argument parser at all and silently ignore every flag, executing their real (possibly mutating) procedure regardless of what was passed. Before running an unfamiliar tool "just to see the help text", grep the script for argparse/add_argument or equivalent; if none exists, treat any invocation as a real run, not a dry-run.

decisions.notes: Concrete CLI-safety lesson from an actual incident this session.
